annotation_method: Manual review of original source frames; release interval spans last attached-ball and first clearly detached-ball frames. Midpoint used uniformly. Bounce uses previously reported tracker event, visually reviewed here, +/-0.5 frame nominal uncertainty. Retrospective pilot, not blinded: answer file was seen before annotation. No annotations adjusted using metric bounce error.

assumptions.note: point-contact z=0 approximation; radius is used only for aerodynamic area. No spin, swing, wind, or camera calibration. Parameters fixed across clips, not fitted to example ground truth.
